title: 第13章 猎魔小队
content_zh:
这一晚，回到家的李皓很晚才入睡。
哪怕睡着了，也格外小心，黑豹被他丢到了门口看门，旋涡三代一直放在手边，走火的风险李皓都顾不上了，他担心狗急跳墙。
好在，这一夜并无任何意外。
也许，对方还在等待，等待雨夜的到来。
1730年，7月13日。
昨夜的喧闹，好像一场梦，启明小区一如既往的安静，没人在意隔壁老街昨晚的动静。
也许有人注意到了，也不会当回事。
李皓起床，洗漱，接着烧了一杯开水，将玉剑置入开水中。
等待了一会。
开水稍微冷却了一些，李皓尝了一口，微微皱起了眉头。
“星光能量稍微少了一些。”
李皓若有所思，比起昨日，今日的泡剑水，蕴含的星光能量好像少了一点点。
“如果只是少一点，问题不大，关键在于，这神秘能，是否可以恢复……”
这才是李皓关心的问题。
玉剑上的神秘能，是之前蕴藏的能量，还是说，泡剑一次，需要一定的时间才能恢复到原本的水平，如果可以恢复，那就是无穷无尽的宝藏！
至于石刀，李皓暂时没有动用。
昨夜担心被人跟踪，他也不方便取出石刀。
喝了一杯水，感受到暖流在体内流淌，李皓迅速练习五禽猿术，哪怕再怎么提升，未必可以对付红影，可能提升是好事，李皓不会放过机会的。
一边锻炼，李皓一边思考着。
这星空剑泡水，是一天多泡几次好，还是一天就泡一次，每一次泡出来的水，效果差距到底大不大？

这些，都需要他慢慢去试验才行。
房间中，李皓身影依旧敏捷，四处乱窜，如同猿猴。
这一次，没有昨晚练习的次数多。
连续练习了三次，感觉还有余力，李皓便不再锻炼，体表外的星光能量，也全部消散，李皓也是等到体外星光能量消散，这才选择了终止。
他担心，担心红影或者其他超能者，可以和自己一样，看到体表的星光能。
若是如此，那就暴露了。
刘隆那几人，体表外都有淡淡的星光能，李皓一眼就可以看出来，所以这些家伙，根本瞒不住李皓的眼睛。
“以前也见过刘隆，倒是没发现……”
李皓心中想着，回忆了一下昨晚的情况，以前没看见刘隆体表外的星光，是因为自己眼睛看不到，还是因为最近刘隆才有了变化？
又或者，因为自己喝了泡剑水，所以才能看到？
如今的自己，对这一切，都了解的太少太少了。
“超凡世界！”
李皓再次清洗了一番，换了身衣服，显得清爽许多。
将碗中剩下的泡剑水，倒进了黑豹的食盆，黑豹狗眼中满是兴奋，几乎是迫不及待地迅速舔完，舔完了还不够，一个劲地朝李皓摇尾巴。
而李皓，仔细看了一阵黑豹，微微吸了口气。
“好家伙！”
这狗身上的星光，感觉比自己还要浓郁一些，这是散发的多，吸收的少？
还是反过来，吸收的多，动静大，引发了星光泛滥？
李皓不知道！
他宁愿去想，这狗吸收不了，星光溢散了出来，否则，岂不是说这条狗都比自己厉害，吸收的星光能量比自己还多。

“汪汪！”
黑豹很是兴奋，好像在说，再来一杯。
李皓摸了摸狗头，笑了笑，“没了！下次再喝！”
说着，叮嘱道：“我去上班，你看家！除了我，任何人来了，都要注意！记下味道，要是允许，可以跟踪一下位置……不要跑太远。”
他担心自己离开，会有人潜进自己的家。
玉剑在自己身上，家里其实也没什么值钱的东西。
当然，昨晚拿回来的石刀，那也是宝物。
不过石刀倒是不怕被人发现，虽然石头有些大，不方便携带在身上，可李皓将石刀丢在了楼下黑豹的狗窝里，谁会发现？
至于被路人捡走了，开玩笑，谁会去野狗窝里捡走一块石头？
打扫卫生，小区这边，闲得慌才会给你打扫野狗窝。
总之，没有哪里比狗窝更安全了。
而且真丢了，黑豹也能知道，跟踪到，反正比放在自己身上安全，玉剑是挂坠没事，谁没事带块石头在身上，傻子也知道有问题了。
“汪！”
黑豹听懂了李皓的话，狗脑袋点了点，这家伙愈发聪明了。
李皓起身，迈步朝楼下走去。
小区外，熟悉的早点铺子，不用李皓开口，老板就递来了几个大肉包子，一杯豆浆。
李皓也不吃白食，付好了钱，慢悠悠地骑着自行车朝巡检司骑去。
昨天下班，跟着自己的黑车没有出现。
不知道是放弃了跟踪，还是因为昨晚的事，现在不敢轻易跟踪自己。
一直等李皓进入巡检司，都没感受到那种被跟踪的感觉。

巡检司。
机要室。
李皓是第一个来的。
一如既往，先简单清扫一下办公室，烧了壶热水，这才陆续有人到来。
陈娜资历不深，来的也算早。
天气有些炎热，大早上的，陈娜就有些犯困，可能昨晚没睡好，打着哈欠，看到李皓，有些抱怨：“李皓，你可不够意思！昨晚你查案，怎么没喊我？”
“你也知道？”
“废话！”
陈娜打着哈欠道：“当然知道，昨晚执法队都出动了！”
事情闹的不小，她自然也收到了消息。
很快，陈娜晃着脑袋，将困意驱散，有些好奇道：“你昨晚遇到凶手了？”
“没。”
李皓摇头：“就是感觉被人跟踪了。”
“这么刺激？”
陈娜还没参与过什么大案，顿时来了兴趣，兴奋道：“这么说，你之前给我看的那几个人卷宗，都是真的他杀？”
李皓微微点头：“大概率是。”
“那你要立功了！”
陈娜愈加兴奋了：“李皓，这要是查到了凶手，你是首功，说不定就这一个案子，你都能升到二级巡检了！”
有些羡慕，更多的还是李皓可以参与大案，她没能参与的遗憾。
她可不是耐得住寂寞的性子。

“还没线索呢。”
李皓没有多说什么，陈娜眼珠子一转，很快小声道：“之前不是说好了，明天去我老家吗？李皓，还去不去？去的话，咱们会不会被人跟踪？李皓，你说咱俩要是合伙抓到了凶手，是不是我也有功？”
昨天，李皓和她说好了，明天一起去陈娜老家，打听一下俚曲的事。
可昨日，李皓不知道这么快就被人盯上了，凶险万分，甚至红影都出现了。
此刻，李皓有些迟疑。
看了一眼陈娜，还是开口道：“算了，不去了。咱们都是新手，太危险了，最近还是低调一些。”
他不想将这位同僚牵扯进来。
涉及到超凡超能领域，太危险了。
至于俚曲的事，不急于一时，反正现在知道了情况，真感兴趣，等弄死了红影，以后再去追查也不迟。
“啊？不去了？”
陈娜顿时满脸遗憾，她还想参与大案呢！
“李皓，去呗，怕什么，大不了和执法队说一声，咱们当诱饵，说不定可以直接抓人！”
她也知道有风险，可通知执法队一起好了。
“再看吧！”
两人聊了几句，其他人也陆续到来。
不少人都知道了昨晚的事，俞大姐一进门就语气泼辣道：“小皓啊，你可别犯傻！这种危险的案子，你可别瞎掺和，咱们机要室活少危险少，工资还不少！这么好的事，你到哪找去？乖乖在机要室待着，别掺和执法队的事！”
“就是，小皓，听你老大哥一句劝，少掺和这些，危险不说，还没啥好处。”
“……”
众人还是很关心这位小老弟的，纷纷劝说。
在机要室待着，早已让大家对查案的事生疏了，如今让他们上一线，恐怕也没几个愿意的。

李皓也不反驳，一直点头，脸上满是良善。
好像在说，我也没办法，刚好牵扯进来了。
一直到王杰进门，众人这才消停了下来。
“李皓，来我办公室一趟！”
王杰说了一句，很快进办公室了。
而李皓，稍微等待了一会，也起身朝办公室走去。
办公室内。
王杰仔细打量了李皓一阵，笑了，按了按手：“坐！”
李皓小心翼翼地坐下。
王杰失笑，“不用这么拘谨，太拘谨了，在执法队可不好混。”
李皓抬头。
王杰看向他：“执法队那边，昨晚就给我致电，说要调你过去，刘隆可是很少会开口的，而且直接亲自出面要人，也很难得，相当重视！李皓，看来你因为自焚案，算是进了刘隆的眼，执法队要你过去，你怎么想？”
实际上，王杰拒绝不了。
至于李皓，王杰觉得，也抗拒不了，当然，据说李皓的老师相当关注李皓，真要拒绝，也不是问题。
执法队的刘隆，地位可比他王杰高不少。
而且正儿八经地实权派！
王杰想听听李皓的想法。
而李皓，稍微考虑了一下，低下头，轻声道：“室长，我想过去！机要室很好，我很喜欢，可您知道，我进入巡检司，其实就一个目标……给我朋友报仇！”
“哎！”
王杰叹息一声：“能理解，其实你走，我很舍不得，你不走，我也准备向上级打报告，看看能不能给你升一级。可你心里惦记着自焚案的事，那我也不会拦你。”

“只是，你要小心，执法队比机要室危险的多，每年都有伤亡。尤其是自焚案，我建议你主要负责一些文案工作，别去一线，这事听起来就没那么简单！执法队如果处理不了，很可能会引起更高层的关注。”
李皓默默点头。
王杰见状，也不多说什么，他其实挺喜欢李皓这年轻人的。
可人家来巡检司，目标就是这个，倒也无法再劝。
“自焚案结束，你要是还想回来，可以打报告，随时欢迎你回来！”
“谢谢室长！”
李皓道谢一声，王杰笑道：“别客气，你先去执法队报个到，看看他们什么时候正式调人，回头调令下来了，机要室组织一下欢送会。”
“谢谢室长！”
李皓再次道谢，在机要室，大家对他都挺好的。
其实若不是情况到了这地步，他也觉得留在机要室是不错的选择。
从室长办公室出来，李皓没有和其他人说，自己要调走了。
也没有收拾什么东西，李皓和陈娜打了个招呼，出去一趟，很快就朝执法队那边走去。
执法队和机要室都在巡检司总部。
不过，双方不在一栋楼。
机要室就在巡检大厅后面的办公室，而执法队，却是在旁边一栋楼里面，整个大楼，都是执法队的地盘，比机要室要阔气的多。
穿着巡检制服的李皓，走到执法大楼门口，没人阻拦。
大楼门口，来来往往的执法队成员，一个个都看起来彪悍的很。
李皓和他们比，就显得有些瘦弱不起眼了。
没有问人，李皓一路朝楼上走去。
他去找柳艳。

柳艳是执法队副队长，有自己的办公室，办公室在六楼。
很快，李皓上了六楼。
六楼没什么人，都是一些领导办公室。
看了一圈，找到了铭牌，很快，李皓敲响了一间办公室的门。
“进来！”
柳艳的声音，没有昨晚的风情，倒是多了一些冷酷。
直到李皓推门而入，下一刻，柳艳语气变化了一下，带着一些笑意，“哟，小李皓来了，看样子，昨晚没睡好，大早上就想姐姐了？”
“柳队早！”
李皓敬了个礼，不为所动，规矩的很。
风情万种，对自己没吸引力。
何况，危机四伏，也没兴趣欣赏这位的风姿，更别说，这位柳队不简单，还和刘隆是一伙的，李皓也不想给自己找麻烦。
“小李皓，这么正经做什么？”
柳艳笑靥如花，李皓却是一板一眼，站的笔直，余光扫了一眼这位的办公室。
心中暗暗震动。
办公室很大，感觉不比机要室办公区小了，起码一两百平。
关键不在于这个，执法队阔气一点正常，不正常的是，李皓一眼就看到了一些摆放在办公室中的大规模杀伤性武器。
旋涡三代算什么？
这样的小手枪，放在这就是垃圾！
暴风一号！
这个李皓听说过，杀伤力极强，冲锋类枪械，装弹一次三百发，可以连发。

鹰眼四代，最先进的狙击型枪械，精准射程五百米以上，实际杀伤范围更大。
破甲二代，据说可以直接穿透钢铁。
这哪是办公室，这是军火库啊！
李皓心中震动。
而柳艳好像看到了他的表情变化，顿时笑了起来：“小李皓，别惊讶，这都是模型，姐姐摆着玩的，可不是真的！”
李皓无语，你觉得我信吗？
那金属的质感，散发出幽冷的金属光芒，这是模型？
你当我眼瞎呢！
执法队这边，真够可以的，柳艳居然堂而皇之地将这些大杀伤性武器就摆放在自己办公室。
“真是模型！”
柳艳笑了起来，忽然伸手拿起一颗黑色手雷，直接朝李皓一丢，“玩玩，没事的！”
李皓眼神一变，急忙接入手中。
头上隐约都有冷汗渗透出来！
不会爆炸吧？
“别怕！”
柳艳靠近过来，笑呵呵的，见李皓伸手接过，随意将手雷上的插销一拔，笑呵呵道：“没事，插销都没拔，哪有事？”
李皓头皮发麻！
你疯了吧？
她居然拔了插销！
这一刻，李皓有些想逃。

还好，很快，柳艳笑了起来，伸手取走了手雷，随意朝窗外一扔。
“真没事，假的！”
一声巨响传出，房间都震动了一下。
李皓脸色发白，假的？
还有，这女人疯了吧，你直接就给扔下去了，还爆炸了，这……这也没事？
柳艳却是一直盯着他看，见李皓脸色发白，忽然收起了笑容，有些平淡道：“小李皓，这可不行！”
“嗯？”
“这就吓到了？”
柳艳回到了自己的座位，靠在椅子上，很没形象地将双脚搭在了办公桌上，懒洋洋道：“超能者，可不是这东西可比的！有些家伙，随意一个小火球，也许威力就胜过这个！稍有不慎……你就死了！你连手雷爆炸都怕，胆子太小了，如何能加入我们？”
李皓微微皱眉，很快舒展眉头：“我对这些，都不懂！我只是普通人，就算真的加入执法队，也未必会和这些人打交道，柳队长，我怕才是应该的，也许多几次，我会更习惯一点。”
“是吗？”
柳艳笑了：“你这么胆小，可和老大说的不一样，他说你胆子很大！实际上，我也觉得你胆子不小，真要胆小，你明知自焚案不简单，还敢一直追查下去？”
“有些事，必须要做罢了！”
李皓此刻也恢复了平静：“明知山有虎，偏向虎山行！就如柳队你们，明知道超能者不好惹，可照样去招惹，是不怕吗？我觉得，没人不怕，只是……有时候必须要做罢了！”
“有道理！”
柳艳点头，这一次倒是很赞同，再次笑了起来：“说的不错，没人不怕，我也怕，老大其实也怕！可怕，不代表我们就会放弃！”
她看向李皓：“我不觉得你会给我们带来什么帮助，但是……老大既然说了，那我欢迎你加入执法队，这不重要，重要的是，欢迎你加入猎魔小队！”
李皓眼神微动，这就是他们几人小队的名称吗？
看着柳艳伸过来的手，李皓伸手便要去握。
刚接触，李皓就是心中一惊，下一刻，柳艳手腕用力，一把擒拿住李皓的右手，反手一扭，在李皓都没来得及反应的瞬间，柳艳一个过肩摔，砰地一声，李皓重重砸倒在地！

倒地瞬间，李皓迅速跳起。
猿术练了三年，终究还是有些效果的，李皓一个弹跳，强忍着疼痛，瞬间跳出了柳艳攻击范围。
而柳艳没有再出手，只是安静地看着。
带着一些欣赏的意味，调笑道：“不错！虽然警惕性差了一点点，身手也一般，可反应能力还行，这是五禽新书中的猿术吧？练的还可以！”
李皓沉默不语，满是警惕。
心中也很震动，这女人看起来柔弱，刚刚下手，感觉对方的手如同钢铁，擒拿自己的手臂，不用看，李皓也知道自己手臂肿了！
力气很大！
他感觉自己好像被钢铁给箍住了！
“试试你的身手罢了，别害怕！”
柳艳巧笑如烟，风情万种地笑了起来，眉眼含波，又恢复了之前的模样。
而李皓，却是再也不敢大意了！
“你有五禽术的基础，是好事，猿术不擅攻，却是擅逃，你要是能练到你老师的地步，一般的超能者都未必能追上你！”
此话一出，李皓眼神微动，想了想，低声道：“柳队的意思是……我老师的猿术很强？”
“嗯？”
柳艳一愣，下一刻，笑的前俯后仰，花枝灿烂。
“五禽新书谁编的？袁老编的！你怀疑一位编造出《五禽新书》的创造者，五禽术不强？”
柳艳笑了一阵，猛然停下，“很强！你老师袁硕，虽然不是超能者，可当年超能不现的时候，你老师是凡俗领域的顶级高手！不过等到超能出现，不入超能领域……哎！”
一声叹息，不知是为袁硕可惜，还是在为自己哀叹。
凡俗武艺高深，那又如何？
再好的身手，也许也挡不住超能者的一个火球，一抹刀光，一道闪电。

这就是悲哀！
不过很快，柳艳清醒了过来，笑容收敛，迈步朝外走去：“走，去找老大，也顺便让你了解一下我们在做什么，你该做什么，对敌人，对自己都有些了解，不指望你如何，别拖后腿就行！”
李皓心脏跳动起来。
也许，在刘隆这，可以了解更多关于超能的知识，而这，便是自己跨入超能的第一步。
这些人敢对超能者下手，一定有不弱的了解。
这也是李皓想加入执法队的另外一个重要原因，只有了解对手，才能更好地对付红影。

That night, Li Hao went to bed very late when he returned home.
Even if he fell asleep, he was extra careful. He threw the black panther at the door and guarded it. The third generation of the whirlpool was always at hand. Li Hao didn't care about the risk of fire. He was worried that the dog would jump over the wall in a hurry.
Fortunately, there were no surprises this night.
Maybe, the other party is still waiting, waiting for the rainy night to come.
July 13, 1730.
The noise last night seemed like a dream. Qiming Community was as quiet as ever. No one paid attention to what happened in the old street next door last night.
Maybe someone noticed it and didn't take it seriously.
Li Hao got up, washed, then boiled a cup of boiling water and placed the jade sword in the boiling water.
Waited for a while.
The boiling water cooled down a bit. Li Hao took a sip and frowned slightly.
"The starlight energy is a little less."
Li Hao thought thoughtfully. Compared with yesterday, the starlight energy contained in today's sword soaking water seems to be a little less.
"If it's just a little less, it's not a big problem. The key is whether this mysterious energy can be restored..."
This is what Li Hao is concerned about.
Is the mysterious energy on the jade sword the energy contained before, or is it that once the sword is soaked, it will take a certain amount of time to return to its original level. If it can be restored, it will be an endless treasure!
As for the stone knife, Li Hao has not used it yet.
Worried about being followed last night, it was inconvenient for him to take out the stone knife.
After drinking a glass of water and feeling the warm current flowing through his body, Li Hao quickly practiced the Five Animals Ape Technique. No matter how much he improved, he might not be able to deal with Hongying. Maybe improvement was a good thing, and Li Hao would not miss the opportunity.
While exercising, Li Hao was thinking.
Is it better to soak the Starry Sky Sword in water several times a day, or just once a day? Is there a big difference in the effect of the water produced every time?
These all require him to experiment slowly.
In the room, Li Hao's figure was still agile, running around like an ape.
This time, not as many times as last night’s practice.
After practicing three times in a row, Li Hao felt that he still had enough energy to stop exercising. All the starlight energy outside his body also dissipated. Li Hao also waited until the starlight energy outside his body dissipated before he chose to stop.
He was worried that Hong Ying or other superpowers could see the starlight energy on the body's surface just like him.
If so, it's exposed.
Liu Long's group of people have faint starlight energy outside their bodies, and Li Hao can see it at a glance, so these guys can't hide it from Li Hao's eyes.
"I've seen Liu Long before, but I didn't notice..."
Li Hao thought in his mind and recalled what happened last night. I didn't see the starlight outside Liu Long's body before. Was it because he couldn't see it with his own eyes, or was it because Liu Long had changed recently?
Or maybe it was because he drank the sword-soaking water that he could see it?
Today, I know too little about all of this.
"Supernatural world!"
Li Hao washed himself again and changed his clothes, looking much fresher.
He poured the remaining sword soaking water in the bowl into the panther's food bowl. The panther dog's eyes were full of excitement and he almost couldn't wait to lick it up quickly. When it was not enough, he kept wagging his tail at Li Hao.
Li Hao, on the other hand, looked at the Black Panther carefully for a while and took a slight breath.
"Good guy!"
The starlight on this dog feels stronger than my own. Is it because it emits more and absorbs less?
Or is it the other way around, absorbing more and making more noise, causing a flood of starlight?
Li Hao doesn’t know!
He would rather think that the dog couldn't absorb it and the starlight overflowed. Otherwise, wouldn't it mean that this dog was more powerful than him and absorbed more starlight energy than he did.
"Woof woof!"
The black panther was very excited, as if saying, have another drink.
Li Hao touched the dog's head and smiled, "No more! I'll drink it next time!"
After saying that, he warned: "I'm going to work, and you look after the house! Anyone other than me should pay attention when he comes!"Make a note of the smell and track the location if allowed...don't wander too far. "
He was worried that if he left, someone would sneak into his home.
The jade sword is on me, but there is nothing valuable at home.
Of course, the stone knife I got back last night is also a treasure.
However, the stone knife was not afraid of being discovered. Although the stone was a bit big and inconvenient to carry around, Li Hao threw the stone knife into the Black Panther's kennel downstairs. Who would find out?
As for being picked up by passers-by, just kidding, who would pick up a stone from a wild dog den?
Cleaning, here in the community, I will clean the wild dog den for you only when you are free.
After all, there is no place safer than a doghouse.
And if it is really lost, the Black Panther will know it and track it. It is safer than leaving it on him anyway. The jade sword is just a pendant. If anyone has a stone on his body, even a fool will know that there is a problem.
"Woof! "
Black Panther understood Li Hao's words and nodded his head. This guy became smarter and smarter.
Li Hao stood up and walked downstairs.
Outside the community, at a familiar breakfast shop, the boss handed over a few big meat buns and a cup of soy milk without Li Hao opening his mouth.
Li Hao didn't want to take anything for granted, so he paid the money and slowly rode his bicycle towards the inspection department.
When I got off work yesterday, the black car that followed me didn't show up.
I don't know if he gave up tracking, or because of what happened last night, he doesn't dare to follow him easily now.
Until Li Hao entered the inspection department, he never felt the feeling of being followed.
Inspection Department.
Confidential room.
Li Hao was the first to come.
As always, I briefly cleaned the office and boiled a pot of hot water, and then people began to arrive.
Chen Na is not very experienced and came early.
The weather was a bit hot, and it was early in the morning. Chen Na felt a little sleepy. She might not have slept well last night, so she yawned. When she saw Li Hao, she complained a little: "Li Hao, you are not interesting enough!" Why didn't you call me when you were investigating the case last night? "
"You know too? "
"Nonsense! "
Chen Na yawned and said: "Of course I know, the law enforcement team was dispatched last night! "
The matter was quite serious, so she naturally received the news.
Soon, Chen Na shook her head to dispel her sleepiness and asked curiously: "Did you meet the murderer last night? "
"without. "
Li Hao shook his head: "I just feel like I'm being followed. "
"So exciting? "
Chen Na had never been involved in any major cases, so she suddenly became interested and said excitedly: "So, those files on those people you showed me before were all true homicides? "
Li Hao nodded slightly: "Most likely. "
"Then you have to make a contribution! "
Chen Na became even more excited: "Li Hao, if the murderer is found and you are the first to be responsible, maybe you can be promoted to the second level inspection just for this case! "
There was some envy, but more of it was the regret that Li Hao could participate in a major case and she couldn't.
She doesn't have the temper to endure loneliness.
“No clues yet. "
Li Hao didn't say much, Chen Na rolled her eyes and quickly whispered: "Didn't I agree before that I would go to my hometown tomorrow? Li Hao, are you still going? If we go, will we be followed? Li Hao, do you think that if we work together to catch the murderer, will I also take credit? "
Yesterday, Li Hao made an agreement with her to go to Chen Na's hometown together tomorrow to inquire about slang music.
But yesterday, Li Hao didn't know that he would be targeted so quickly. He was so dangerous that even a red shadow appeared.
At this moment, Li Hao hesitated.
After glancing at Chen Na, she said, "Forget it, I won't go. We are all newbies, it is too dangerous, so we have been keeping a low profile recently. "
He didn't want to involve his colleague.
It’s too dangerous when it comes to the realm of extraordinary powers.
As for the matter of Liqu, there is no rush. Anyway, now that I know the situation, I am really interested. It will not be too late to pursue it after Hongying is killed.
"Huh? Not going? "
Chen Na suddenly felt regretful, she still wanted to participateWith the big case!
"Li Hao, go ahead. What are you afraid of? At worst, tell the law enforcement team that we can be used as bait and maybe we can arrest people directly!"
She also knows that there are risks, so she can inform the law enforcement team and we can work together.
"Look again!"
The two chatted for a while, and other people arrived one after another.
Many people knew what happened last night. As soon as Sister Yu entered the door, she said in a fierce tone: "Xiao Hao, don't be stupid! Don't get involved in such a dangerous case. Our confidential room has less work, less risk, less risk, and the salary is good! Where can you find such a good thing? Just stay in the confidential room and don't interfere with the law enforcement team!"
"That's right, Xiao Hao, listen to your big brother's advice and stop getting involved in these things. Not to mention the danger, there is no benefit."
"..."
Everyone was still very concerned about this little brother and tried to persuade him one after another.
Staying in the confidential room has already made everyone unfamiliar with investigating cases. Now that they are asked to go to the front line, I am afraid not many are willing.
Li Hao didn't refute and kept nodding, his face full of kindness.
It seems to be saying, I can't help it, I just happened to be involved.
It wasn't until Wang Jie entered that everyone stopped.
"Li Hao, come to my office!"
Wang Jie said something and quickly entered the office.
Li Hao, after waiting for a while, also got up and walked towards the office.
Inside the office.
Wang Jie looked at Li Hao carefully for a while, smiled, and pressed his hand: "Sit down!"
Li Hao sat down carefully.
Wang Jie laughed and said, "Don't be so formal. It's too formal. It's not easy to get along in the law enforcement team."
Li Hao looked up.
Wang Jie looked at him: "The law enforcement team called me last night and said they wanted to transfer you there. Liu Long rarely speaks up, and it is rare for him to directly ask for someone in person. He takes it very seriously! Li Hao, it seems that you have caught Liu Long's eye because of the self-immolation case. The law enforcement team wants you to come over. What do you think?"
In fact, Wang Jie couldn't refuse.
As for Li Hao, Wang Jie felt that he couldn't resist. Of course, it was said that Li Hao's teacher was very concerned about Li Hao, so if he really wanted to refuse, it wouldn't be a problem.
Liu Long of the law enforcement team has a much higher status than Wang Jie.
And he is a serious power holder!
Wang Jie wanted to hear what Li Hao thought.
Li Hao, after thinking about it for a moment, lowered his head and said softly: "Chief, I want to go there! The confidential room is very good, I like it very much, but you know, I entered the Inspection Department with one goal...to avenge my friend!"
"Hey!"
Wang Jie sighed: "It's understandable. In fact, I'm very reluctant to let you go. If you don't leave, I'm going to report to my superiors to see if I can upgrade you to a higher level. But if you are worried about the self-immolation case, I won't stop you."
"But, you have to be careful. The law enforcement team is much more dangerous than the confidential room. There are casualties every year. Especially for self-immolation cases, I suggest you mainly be responsible for some desk work and not go to the front line. This matter is not that simple as it sounds! If the law enforcement team cannot handle it, it is likely to attract higher-level attention."
Li Hao nodded silently.
When Wang Jie saw this, he didn't say much. He actually liked this young man Li Hao.
But this is the goal of people coming to the inspection department, so there is nothing I can do to persuade them.
"The self-immolation case is over. If you still want to come back, you can report it. You are welcome to come back at any time!"
"Thank you, room chief!"
Li Hao thanked him, and Wang Jie said with a smile: "You're welcome, you go to the law enforcement team to report first and see when they will officially transfer people. When the transfer order comes, the confidential office will organize a farewell party."
"Thank you, room chief!"
Li Hao thanked him again. Everyone in the confidential room was very kind to him.
In fact, if the situation hadn't reached this point, he would have thought that staying in the confidential room would be a good choice.
When Li Hao came out of the office director's office, he didn't tell anyone else that he was being transferred.
Without packing anything, Li Hao said hello to Chen Na, went out, and quickly walked towards the law enforcement team.
ExecuteThe legal team and the confidential room are both at the headquarters of the Inspection Department.
However, the two parties are not in the same building.
The confidential room is in the office behind the inspection hall, but the law enforcement team is in a building next to it. The entire building is the territory of the law enforcement team, which is much more luxurious than the confidential room.
Li Hao, wearing an inspection uniform, walked to the door of the law enforcement building without anyone stopping him.
At the entrance of the building, the members of the law enforcement team came and went, all of them looked very tough.
Compared with them, Li Hao looked a little thin and inconspicuous.
Without asking anyone, Li Hao walked all the way upstairs.
He went to find Liu Yan.
Liu Yan is the deputy captain of the law enforcement team and has her own office on the sixth floor.
Soon, Li Hao went to the sixth floor.
There is no one on the sixth floor, just some leadership offices.
After looking around, he found the nameplate. Soon, Li Hao knocked on the door of an office.
"Come in!"
Liu Yan's voice was not as charming as last night, but more cold.
Until Li Hao pushed the door open and walked in, the next moment, Liu Yan's tone changed and she said with a smile, "Hey, little Li Hao is here. It seems that he didn't sleep well last night and missed his sister so early in the morning?"
"Good morning Captain Liu!"
Li Hao saluted, unmoved and behaved.
There are all kinds of charms, which are not attractive to me.
What's more, he was surrounded by dangers and had no interest in appreciating this person's grace. Not to mention, Captain Liu was not simple and was on the same side as Liu Long. Li Hao didn't want to cause trouble for himself.
"Little Li Hao, why are you so serious?"
Liu Yan's smile was as bright as a flower, but Li Hao was serious, standing upright, and glanced at this person's office from the corner of his eye.
My heart was shaken secretly.
The office is very large, no smaller than the confidential office area, at least one to two hundred square meters.
The key is not this. It is normal for the law enforcement team to be lavish. What is abnormal is that Li Hao saw some weapons of mass destruction placed in the office at a glance.
What is the third generation of Uzumaki?
Such a small pistol is just garbage if left here!
Storm One!
Li Hao had heard of it. It was an extremely lethal assault-type firearm. It could be loaded with 300 rounds at a time and could be fired continuously.
The fourth generation of Hawkeye is the most advanced sniper firearm with an accurate range of more than 500 meters and a larger actual killing range.
The second generation armor-piercing weapon is said to be able to penetrate steel directly.
This is not an office, this is an arsenal!
Li Hao was shocked.
Liu Yan seemed to have seen the change in his expression, and immediately laughed: "Little Li Hao, don't be surprised, these are all models. My sister is just showing them off for fun, they are not real!"
Li Hao was speechless, do you think I believe it?
The metallic texture exudes a cold metallic light. Is this a model?
You think I'm blind!
As for the law enforcement team, it's really impressive that Liu Yan openly placed these weapons of mass destruction in her office.
“What a model!”
Liu Yan laughed, suddenly reached out and picked up a black grenade, and threw it directly at Li Hao, "It's just for fun, it's okay!"
Li Hao's eyes changed and he quickly took it into his hand.
There was a faint cold sweat seeping out of my head!
It won't explode, right?
"Don't be afraid!"
Liu Yan came closer and smiled. When she saw Li Hao reaching out to take it, he casually pulled out the pin on the grenade and said with a smile: "It's okay. I didn't even pull out the pin. What's the matter?"
Li Hao's scalp was numb!
Are you crazy?
She actually pulled the latch!
At this moment, Li Hao wanted to escape.
Fortunately, soon, Liu Yan laughed, reached out and took away the grenade, and threw it casually out of the window.
"It's really okay, it's fake!"
There was a loud noise and the room shook.
Li Hao's face turned pale. Is it fake?
Also, is this woman crazy? You just threw her down and exploded. This... is this okay?
Liu Yan kept staring at him. When she saw Li Hao's face turned pale, she suddenly stopped smiling and said somewhat plainly: "Little Li Hao, this is not okay!"
"Huh?"
"Is this scary?"
willowYan returned to her seat, leaned back on the chair, put her feet on the desk in an awkward manner, and said lazily: "Superpowers are not comparable to this thing! Some guys, a small fireball may be more powerful than this! If you are not careful... you will die! You are even afraid of grenade explosions, you are too timid, how can you join us?"
Li Hao frowned slightly and quickly relaxed his brows: "I don't understand any of this! I'm just an ordinary person. Even if I really join the law enforcement team, I may not be able to deal with these people. Captain Liu, I'm afraid that's what I should do. Maybe a few more times, I'll get more used to it."
"Really?"
Liu Yan smiled: "You are so timid, but it is different from what the boss said. He said you are very courageous! In fact, I also think you are very courageous. You really must be timid. You know that the self-immolation case is not simple, but you still dare to keep pursuing it?"
"Some things have to be done!"
Li Hao also regained his composure at this moment: "You know that there are tigers in the mountains, but you prefer to go to the tiger mountains! Just like Captain Liu, you know that superpowers are not easy to mess with, but you still go to provoke them. Aren't you afraid? I think no one is not afraid, but... sometimes you have to do it!"
"That makes sense!"
Liu Yan nodded, agreeing with it this time, and laughed again: "You're right, no one is not afraid, I am afraid too, and the boss is actually afraid too! Just because it's scary, doesn't mean we will give up!"
She looked at Li Hao: "I don't think you will bring us any help, but... since the boss said it, I welcome you to join the law enforcement team. This is not important. What is important is that you are welcome to join the demon hunting team!"
Li Hao's eyes moved slightly. Is this the name of their team?
Looking at Liu Yan's extended hand, Li Hao stretched out his hand to shake it.
As soon as they made contact, Li Hao was shocked. The next moment, Liu Yan grabbed Li Hao's right hand with force, and twisted it with her backhand. Before Li Hao had time to react, Liu Yan threw her over her shoulder, and with a bang, Li Hao fell heavily to the ground!
The moment he fell to the ground, Li Hao jumped up quickly.
After practicing the ape technique for three years, it finally had some effect. Li Hao jumped, endured the pain, and instantly jumped out of Liu Yan's attack range.
But Liu Yan didn't take action again, just watched quietly.
With some appreciation, he said with a smile: "Not bad! Although my vigilance is a little bit off and my skills are average, my reaction ability is not bad. Is this the ape technique in Wu Qin's new book? I can practice it well!"
Li Hao was silent and full of vigilance.
He was also shocked in his heart. This woman looked weak. Just as he started to attack, he felt that the opponent's hand was like steel, grabbing his arm. Even without looking, Li Hao knew that his arm was swollen!
Great strength!
He felt as if he was trapped by steel!
"Just try your skills, don't be afraid!"
Liu Yanqiao smiled like smoke, smiling charmingly, her brows and eyes were twitching, and she returned to her previous appearance.
But Li Hao never dared to be careless again!
"It's a good thing that you have the foundation of Five Animal Techniques. Ape Technique is not good at attacking, but it is good at escaping. If you can practice it to the level of your teacher, ordinary superpowers may not be able to catch up with you!"
As soon as these words came out, Li Hao's eyes moved slightly, he thought for a while, and whispered: "What Captain Liu means... is my teacher's ape technique very strong?"
"Huh?"
Liu Yan was stunned for a moment, and the next moment, she was leaning forward and back with a smile, and the branches were bright.
"Who compiled the New Book of Five Animals? Mr. Yuan compiled it! Do you doubt that the creator who made up the New Book of Five Animals is not strong in the Five Animals technique?"
Liu Yan laughed for a while, then stopped suddenly, "Very strong! Although your teacher Yuan Shuo is not a superpower, when superpowers did not appear, your teacher was a top expert in the ordinary field! But when superpowers appear, he will not enter the superpower field... ugh!"
A sigh, I don't know if it's a pity for Yuan Shuo, or a lament for myself.
Ordinary martial arts are superb, so what?
No matter how good your skills are, you may not be able to block a fireball from a superpower.A flash of sword light, a flash of lightning.
This is sad!
But soon, Liu Yan came to her senses, her smile faded, and she walked out: "Let's go find the boss, and let you know what we are doing, what you should do, and understand the enemy and yourself. I don't expect you to do anything, just don't hold back!"
Li Hao's heart beat.
Perhaps, Liu Long can learn more about superpowers, and this is his first step into superpowers.
These people who dare to attack superpowers must have a good understanding of them.
This is another important reason why Li Hao wants to join the law enforcement team. Only by understanding the opponent can he deal with Hongying better.
